display.meaning: I went to the bookshop three times.

choices.label: I went to the bookshop only once.
choices.feedback: I went to the bookshop three times. Verb + number + 回 counts occasions. In 去了三回书店, the count is three visits, not three hours spent there. 回 is the occasion counter in this position, not the verb return.
